title: RETICLE WORDS GROW AT 4K
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, the same size on every screen. The crosshair grew with the screen at v9.53, but the words under it (NO AMMO, JAMMED, [R] RELOAD), the reload seconds beside it and the widths of the magazine and reload rings kept their 1080p size, so on a 4K screen they were small print beside a big cross. They now grow by the same screen factor. At 1080p nothing moves.
now: On a 4K screen NO AMMO, JAMMED, the reload key and the reload seconds by the crosshair are now as big as the crosshair.
